verdict.rationale: AWS documents programmatic control: the Cost Explorer API reference supports programmatic queries, and the official CLI can run commands equivalent to the Management Console and automate them through scripts. However, the pack documents a public API reference for only one service, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths, so complete API coverage across the product is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of documented public API references across core services (EC2, S3, Lambda, etc.), a discoverable machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving AWS via its API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the Cost Explorer API to programmatically query your cost and usage data.
the AWS CLI enables you to start running commands that implement functionality equivalent to that provided by the browser-based AWS Management Console from the command prompt in your terminal program
you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts.
